claim: In a phone browser with no sign-up, Trace Press makes a free 40-page handwriting workbook interior PDF (pre-writing lines, A to Z with start dots, arrows and a picture per letter, then 0 to 9) and its full-wrap KDP cover; the free book carries a footer line and a PREVIEW cover, and $19 once removes them.
notes: Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It ticks pictures, pre-writing lines and numbers, types a title, downloads the interior and the cover (the price dialog shows, then closes), and ends on pages 1, 5 and 34 of that PDF and on its cover, rendered from those files. The final 2.2 s hold the cover still for the end card.
